svg.title: Public aggregate case counts by platform
svg.desc: Stacked bars show Reddit and YouTube rows for sixteen canonical cases, totalling 130,858 case-linked rows. Counts describe this collected corpus, not incident frequency or representative public opinion. No raw posts or user records are included in the figure.
